description: Latest Redfin market snapshot for a Washington area — ZIP code, neighborhood, city, or county: median sale price, year-over-year change, days on market, months of supply, and percent sold above list, with an explicit data-freshness period. Western Washington focus. Aggregate statistics only — no individual listings, parcels, or people. Use for 'how is the market in X' questions; quote the returned numbers verbatim and reproduce the Redfin attribution (required) wherever the numbers are shown. Paused while Sentinel arranges a licensed sale-statistics source: it then answers SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, uncharged. For recorded sale prices use wa_comps (King, Pierce and Snohomish); for price-index and other trends use wa_market_trends. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.
